note: Agency sets the per-source canary may leave uncompared because the source publishes no M2, S2, K1 or O1 for them (otc_pipeline.build_otc.run_canaries). Any other set the canary cannot compare fails the canary. A row whose set is gone, or now publishes all four, stops the build so the row is reviewed.

exceptions.reason: Viker (Hvaler, outer Oslofjord): Kartverket's harmonic constants for VIK have no K1 (46 constituents; O1 2.3 cm, P1 and Q1 are given, K1 is not). The other three canary constituents are resolved; the set is published, and it is left out of the convention comparison only for the missing K1.
